name: Coder
description: Coder v2.36.7 is a self-hosted development-platform control plane with Postgres and a Docker socket for workspace templates.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Postgres password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  coder:
    image: ghcr.io/coder/coder:v2.36.7@sha256:e8b2743529aea6a1e77bba764c8ec4a04dec65d27ca9caa0ec0b2dbcd3db0565
    container_name: coder
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:7080"
    environment:
      CODER_PG_CONNECTION_URL: postgresql://coder:${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@database/coder?sslmode=disable
      CODER_HTTP_ADDRESS: 0.0.0.0:7080
      CODER_ACCESS_URL: http://localhost:7080
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/home:/home/coder
    depends_on:
      database:
        condition: service_healthy
  database:
    image: postgres:17@sha256:d74eeac9a635390a49bc21bd49fccd973de707e2a53a76ac49b552b8712ec46f
    container_name: coder-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: coder
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: coder
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U coder -d coder"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
notes: Open http://localhost:7080 and create the first user. Set CODER_ACCESS_URL to an address workspaces can reach before using templates that are not on this Docker host. When Coder can write to the mounted Docker socket, it can control the host Docker daemon. On a rootful Docker host, users or templates that can make Coder issue Docker requests may gain host-root-equivalent access. Restrict Coder to trusted users and templates. On Linux, if Coder cannot write to the socket, add the host docker group id with group_add. The official Compose file leaves that value commented because it differs per host. The Postgres password is a catalog literal and the database port is not published. Replace it in both POSTGRES_PASSWORD and CODER_PG_CONNECTION_URL if this host is shared. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit those literals; they do not substitute Compose variables.
